The Cecred Styling Studio

Pop Up Mob brought Cécred's campaign Take the Heat. Body the Look. to life at Ulta FLC through the Cécred Styling Studio: set inside a hot-studio gym that fully immersed guests in the Styling Collection's core promise of protection from heat and humidity. Illuminated hair bars invited hands-on testing with the Cécred team, a lit circle moment framed the perfect photo op, and the gym wall sent guests off with a gratis bag.
